newsitem.title: CANADA: Five killed in Canadian helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Canadian helicopter crash.

text.p: Five people were killed when their helicopter crashed in the Rocky Mountains near Kimberley in southwestern British Columbia, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) said on Sunday.
Four passengers were being flown to a mountain lodge on Saturday for a course on dealing with avalanches and cross-country skiing, a spokeswoman for the RCMP in Kimberley said.

A search late on Saturday located the wreckage of the Mountain High company's Star helicopter near Higgins Peak, 12 miles (20 km) northwest of Kimberley, but the bodies of the helicopter's owner-pilot and his four passengers were not located until Sunday.
An RCMP spokeswoman said all five died instantly in the crash and added that the RCMP had no clues yet to the cause of the crash.
